name: io.github.kallehiitola/celgrid-mcp
title: Celgrid Pixel-Native Sprite & Animation Studio
description: Create indexed pixel sprites and animations. Export to Godot, Unity, Phaser, and Aseprite.

environmentVariables.name: CELGRID_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Personal Celgrid API key (cg_live_...) from https://celgrid.ai/settings (optional for reading the guide and browsing public starter packs).

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional BYOK Anthropic API key (pay Anthropic directly + flat 15% Celgrid orchestration fee).

environmentVariables.name: CELGRID_URL
environmentVariables.description: Celgrid server URL (defaults to https://celgrid.ai; override for local self-hosted Studio).

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional for public discovery. For account tools, provide Bearer followed by the personal key from https://celgrid.ai/settings#api-keys.

headers.name: X-Anthropic-Key
headers.description: Optional provider key for BYOK generation with a 15% prepaid Celgrid fee.
